notes.title: Update v0.2.0.0
notes.content:
[list]
    [*]Added two mini-bosses
    [*]Added a way to get gold bars
    [*]Added gold armor
    [*]Added gold shield 
    [*]Added several spells for the player (can be obtained as reward from the bosses)
    [*]Added toolbar for quick using of items
    [*]Added map (Press M on keyboard)
    [*]Fixed problems with death animation playback
    [*]It is no longer possible to change equipment in combat stance
    [*]Restart is now available if the character has low health
    [*]Increased number of ore veins
    [*]The spawn of food in the chests is increased
[/list]

notes.title: Update v0.1.1.0
notes.content:
Changelog:
[list]
    [*]AI enhancements
    [*]Added damage indicator
    [*]Jumps with melee weapons replaced with dodges
    [*]Added VoiceChat (press T for enable)
    [*]Fix for bug with hangup of item's cooldown
    [*]Stability improvements
    [*]Dedicated server (up to 32 players)
[/list]
